sermon.title: The Significant Question
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer asks the significant question whether America and her churches will live the founders’ biblical morals or use grace-talk to excuse mistreatment and immorality. He cites Franklin, Adams, a congressional Bible, Ephesians 2 good works, James 2, and confronts Pew-era cultural sins.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Unverified: 75% church 1740; Pew 2014 70%/22% as spoken. Sensitive: same-sex graphic critique, sanctuary cities, Indian/African mistreatment under grace excuse.

faqs.question: How old was Franklin in the 1787 speech he cites?
What did John Adams say about the Bible?
faqs.answer: He examined all religions and the result is the Bible is the best book in the world.

faqs.question: What church-attendance figure does he cite for 1740?
faqs.answer: Over 75% of people in America went to church, according to the Library of Congress—as spoken, unverified.

faqs.question: Does being saved by grace excuse mistreating Indians or Africans?
faqs.answer: He says no—people used grace-through-faith talk to justify mistreatment; that is not the gospel.

faqs.question: What are we created in Christ Jesus unto?
faqs.answer: Good works—grow up and be righteous.

scriptures.text_nkjv: For we are His workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand that we should walk in them.

faqs.question: What percent does he say claim to be Christian (Pew 2014)?
Is “faith plus nothing” God’s approval?
faqs.answer: He rejects faith-plus-nothing when it equals approval without righteous living.

faqs.question: What does he say about sanctuary cities?
faqs.answer: Immigrants/criminals can break the law and be protected while ordinary citizens face the law.

faqs.question: Is preventative moral teaching better than repair?
faqs.answer: Preventative maintenance is better than reparative—better they learn marriage and morals before damage.

faqs.question: Where does judgment begin according to his closing?
faqs.answer: He points to First Peter 4—judgment beginning at the house of God.

scriptures.text_nkjv: For the time has come for judgment to begin at the house of God; and if it begins with us first, what will be the end of those who do not obey the gospel of God?
